content: The entire cosmos is one single family.
author: Sanskrit Subhashitas
sourceWork: Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam (वसुधैव कुटुम्बकम्) — Maha Upanishad VI.71–73
explanation: To divide humanity into 'ours' and 'theirs' is the shallow impulse of narrow minds. For those who dwell in magnanimous awareness, the entire living earth—all nations, languages, and creatures—is recognized as one sacred, interconnected household.
practicalInsight: Dissolve the barrier of 'us versus them' in your thoughts today. Treat a complete stranger with the warmth you would extend to your own sibling.
reflectionPrompt: Where are you drawing narrow parochial lines around who deserves your compassion and respect?
